Vendored scripts, inlined into rendered documents only when a document uses them:

- mermaid 11.4.1 (MIT) — https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid
- MathJax 3.2.2, tex-svg bundle (Apache-2.0) — https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax

Full license texts and the other dependencies are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at the repository root.
